info.description: Backend API for the sailing competition judging application. Handles regattas, race groups, individual race measurements, sailors, documents, and user authentication.
info.title: Judging of Sailing API

post.description: Authenticates a user with email and password. Returns a JWT token and user info.
Creates a new user (judge, secretary, or admin) with email and password. Returns the created user without the password hash.
Creates a new scoring category (age range, gender, boat class).

get.description: Returns a single category by its UUID.

put.description: Updates an existing category. The ID in the path overrides any ID in the body.

post.description: Uploads a new document (file reference) for a sailor. The file itself should be stored externally; this endpoint stores the reference URL.

get.description: Returns a single document by UUID.

post.description: Sets the document status to "approved". The checked_by field is set to the authenticated user.
Sets the document status to "rejected" with a required comment explaining the reason.
Sets the document status to "need_revision" with a comment explaining what needs to be changed.
Creates a new race group (a single start session with multiple boats). Groups race measurements together.

get.description: Returns all race measurements for a given race group, ordered by boat class and finish time.
Returns a single race group by UUID.

delete.description: Deletes a race group and all associated race measurements.

post.description: Changes the race group status to "finished", indicating the heat has ended and no more measurements can be added.
Changes the race group status to "running", indicating the heat has started.
Records a new individual race measurement for a boat. The judge_id is automatically set from the authenticated user. The sailor_id can be null if the sailor is not yet identified.

get.description: Returns a single race measurement by UUID.

delete.description: Deletes a race measurement by ID.

post.description: Links a previously unlinked race measurement to a sailor. Used when the sailor was not known at measurement time.

patch.description: Updates the finish time, place, and penalty for a race measurement.

get.description: Returns all regattas ordered by start date descending.

post.description: Creates a new regatta with title, dates and optional location.

parameters.description: Regatta details (id, created_at, updated_at are ignored)
parameters.name: regatta

get.description: Returns a single regatta by its UUID.

put.description: Updates an existing regatta. The ID in the path overrides any ID provided in the body.

parameters.description: Updated regatta fields (id from path is used)
parameters.name: regatta

delete.description: Deletes a regatta and all associated data (race groups, races, sailors, documents).

get.description: Returns all race groups (heats) for a given regatta, ordered by group number.
Returns all sailors registered in a given regatta.
Finds a sailor by their boat class and sail number within a specific regatta. Used by judges to link race measurements to sailors.
get.summary: Find sailor by class and sail number

post.description: Registers a new sailor (participant) in a regatta. The combination (regatta_id, boat_class, sail_number) must be unique.

get.description: Returns a single sailor by UUID.

put.description: Updates an existing sailor's details. The ID in the path overrides any ID in the body.

delete.description: Deletes a sailor and all associated documents and race links.

get.description: Returns all documents for a given sailor, ordered by creation date descending.

BearerAuth.description: JWT token obtained from POST /api/v1/auth/login. Use format: Bearer <token>
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
